subject: maths
question: Gopi purchased an artical at (7)/(8) of its selling price. Had he sold it at 20% more than the selling price, then what would his profit percentage be?
solution:
**Given:**

Cost Price (C.P.) = 7/8 of Selling Price (S.P.)

Selling Price (S.P.) = 100 (assumed value)

New Selling Price (N.S.P.) = 120% of the original S.P.

**Formula used:**

Profit % = (Profit / C.P.) × 100
